facts: The recorded startup path is `node harness/init.mjs`; it runs `./mvnw -q verify` and inherits JAVA_HOME/PATH, so it reds on the host default Temurin 25 because the pom.xml Enforcer `requireJavaVersion` requires [21,22).

Homebrew OpenJDK 21.0.12.1 is installed at /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home, but it is keg-only: `/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21` returns /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-25.jdk/Contents/Home, so JDK discovery must consult the Homebrew keg (or a recorded path), not java_home alone.
harness/env/local.json records java.executable=/usr/bin/java (Temurin 25), stale relative to the required JDK 21; refresh its java.home and java.executable to the discovered JDK 21.

The independent discriminator is pre-existing: pom.xml requireJavaVersion [21,22) plus BaselineTest asserting Runtime.version().feature()==21. A wrong or skipped JDK selection cannot pass; keep the Enforcer range and the runtime assertion intact.
Select JDK 21 by setting JAVA_HOME (and the java on PATH) only for the spawned ./mvnw subprocess; do not require or assume a manual export in the caller's shell.
